scope: MAR scientific observatory; instrumentation status and validation boundaries
central_question: Sob quais condições infraestruturais, institucionais, técnicas e culturais os acervos audiovisuais se tornam visíveis, invisíveis, restritos ou instáveis em ambientes digitais?

components.scientific_role: delimit observed public institutional and aggregator corpus
components.may_infer: counts of actually materialized records by declared route and snapshot
components.must_not_infer: total holdings of source institution or representativeness of all European archives

components.scientific_role: allow public consultation and analyze findability of routes and public records
components.may_infer: retrieval and route observations within documented query and platform scope
components.must_not_infer: exhaustive discovery or ranked-retrieval accuracy without a suitable evaluation

components.scientific_role: collect evidence about CMS APIs metadata interoperability search and restrictions
components.may_infer: a signal on the observed URL and observation date
components.must_not_infer: institution-wide technology presence or absence from a single signal

components.scientific_role: study documented use or declared adoption of AI in archival description search access and circulation
components.may_infer: dated levels of detectable declaration or confirmed function when evidence supports it
components.must_not_infer: AI use without evidence or generation/manipulation of a particular video

components.scientific_role: classify public digital surface roles to support observation and sample selection
components.may_infer: development findings or independently reviewed experiment findings within stated universe
components.must_not_infer: model validity solely from CI or from preregistration draft

components.scientific_role: decide item-level eligibility separately from surface-role classification
components.must_not_infer: reliable item retrieval or production suitability

components.scientific_role: make evidence and human decisions attributable reproducible and eligible for publication
components.may_infer: verified integrity under tested software assumptions
components.must_not_infer: actual WORM custody authenticated seals or complete blind review from metadata alone

components.scientific_role: observe appearance restriction loss and change of digital audiovisual visibility across comparable snapshots
components.may_infer: dated changes when repeated snapshots are explicitly comparable
components.must_not_infer: digital extinction from one failed request or from non-comparable snapshots

components.scientific_role: possible future synthesis of validated visibility and findability dimensions
components.may_infer: none until a specified approved index exists
components.must_not_infer: overall institutional score from partial or unreviewed indicators

VAL009.candidate_claim: institutions absent from prior M3 human-labelled sets (not globally new to MAR)

research_protocol_notes.academic_presentation: present_final_adopted_methods_and_material_deviations; preserve engineering chronology in audit log
